description.value: A tidy, well-maintained RV resort directly across from Skaha Lake in central Penticton, with flush washrooms, coin showers, and walking distance to beaches, a splash park, and marina; primarily serviced RV sites with no tent-specific option confirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms an active RV resort in Penticton with detailed amenity descriptions. Phone number on the website ((250) 770-8147) matches the OSM record exactly. The site is exclusively described as an RV resort with 68 fully serviced hookup sites (water, sewer, 30-amp power); no tent camping or hiker/biker sites are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: No tent sites or hiker/biker sites mentioned anywhere on the website; all 68 sites are described as fully serviced RV hookup sites.
Website lists email oxbow@shaw.ca which is absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is exclusively an RV resort with fully serviced hookup sites (water, sewer, 30-amp power); no tent camping or hiker/biker accommodation is mentioned. Without confirmation that self-propelled touring cyclists can book a site, inclusion in a cycling-specific directory warrants human review.

wow_evidence: exclusively an RV resort with 68 fully serviced hookup sites… no tent camping or hiker/biker sites
